editorial.blurb: A hidden gem in Queens serving authentic Thai cuisine that tastes like it's made with love, with every dish bursting with fresh, bold flavor.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for recommendations—they'll steer you toward the Vietnamese spring rolls and chicken curry puffs, and don't miss their creative udon kee mao (drunken noodles with udon instead of traditional noodles).

topDishes.note: Absolutely crunchy with flavorful filling and delicious dipping sauce
